thread:
incident-bot: @oncall.eng paging: canary cluster 'canary-eu-west-1' latency spike > 600ms (p50 210ms -> 820ms) and 5xx rate up (0.2% -> 3.8%). auto-alert: routing_error_rate_high.

maria.gonzalez: acked. pulling dashboards.

jonathan.lee: I see it too — starts ~10:06 UTC, affects ~12% of canary traffic. Canary route 'route-optimizer-v2' shows high error responses from /v1/generate.

sachin.patel: logs show `KeyError` in the routing decision path for some shard ids. Might be new config format mismatch from last deploy.

olivia.kim: tagging customers on watch: small set of requests timed out, but looks like degraded quality rather than full outage. still, 5xx spike is bad.

maria.gonzalez: can we kill the feature flag for that route? `redwood ff kill route-optimizer-v2 canary` would flip to fallback.

samir: I can run the kill-switch. standby.

deploy-bot: deploy event 2798765400: release/opt-routing@abcdef1 rolled to canary-eu-west-1 (10% traffic).

samir: running `redwood feature-flag set route-optimizer-v2 --env canary --state off` now.

samir: done. flag flip confirmed. Canary traffic should go to `route-optimizer-v1` fallback.

jonathan.lee: monitoring... p50 now 230ms, 5xx down to 0.25% — looks like kill-switch helped. Nice.

maria.gonzalez: nice quick mitigation. we should revert the single bad commit while we investigate root cause. who can do the revert and patch?

sachin.patel: I will prepare a patch. suspect commit abcdef1 introduced a parsing change for legacy shard metadata. quick revert followed by small unit test and redeploy to canary.

maria.gonzalez: do the revert as a single-commit revert so we can roll forward safely. Please include the revert SHA in the rollback command.

sachin.patel: working locally. steps: `git revert --no-commit abcdef1` then `git commit -m "revert: routing config change causing KeyError in canary"`, push, open PR to hotfix branch, and ask for expedited CI.

sachin.patel: pushing PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/6428

maria.gonzalez: oncall handoff note: i'll keep monitoring for the next 30m then hand to jon for night. jon, be ready to escalate if rollback doesn't land.

jonathan.lee: got it. I'll take after 10:45 UTC.

deploy-bot: CI checks green for PR 6428. staging rollout started.

sachin.patel: staging looks good, running canary rollout to eu-west-1 at 5% first. command: `kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/router-canary --selector=canary=opt-v1`

olivia.kim: paging customers who might have seen degraded responses: ticket templates queued. We'll send "we detected and mitigated a canary regression; no data loss; region eu-west-1 saw elevated errors for ~12 minutes. Full postmortem pending."

maria.gonzalez: new canary metrics look stable at 5%. bumping to 20% now via deploy pipeline.

deploy-bot: canary to 20% complete. p50 220ms p95 340ms, 5xx 0.18%.

jonathan.lee: good to promote. please stagger to 50% then full. remember to keep kill-switch available if anything funky.

sachin.patel: promoted to 100% canary -> release candidates. final deploy happening.

incident-bot: incident created INC-2026-2798765432: "Canary routing regression (opt-routing)". Severity: Sev2.

maria.gonzalez: summary for handoff: mitigation = feature-flag kill for `route-optimizer-v2` executed, immediate improvements. Root cause suspected parsing change in commit abcdef1. Revert PR 6428 applied and promoted. Monitoring stable. No customer-facing rollback required beyond canary; small number of timed-out requests earlier — OLIVIA will send one-off message to affected accounts.

olivia.kim: message sent to three affected customers and platform-status updated (note: partial degradation, region eu-west-1, short window).

jonathan.lee: taking over oncall at 10:45 UTC. if anything reappears ping @jonathan. I will also schedule a quick post-incident rollup call at 16:00 UTC to agree on permanent fix.

maria.gonzalez: adding runbook items: ensure thresholds for canary alerts include relative change and absolute counts; add unit test for legacy shard metadata parsing; and add a CI gating test for routing config schema.

sachin.patel: will own the follow-up PRs. thanks for the rapid triage team. :thumbsup:

maria.gonzalez: closing thread — will update INC ticket with timeline and logs. handing to jon.

jonathan.lee: acknowledged. logging everything into INC-2026-2798765432.

incident-bot: note: post-incident checklist created. reminder for oncall to fill RCA template within 72 hours.

maria.gonzalez: filing short timeline here for the record:
- 10:06 UTC: deploy/opt-routing@abcdef1 rolled to canary 10%
- 10:09 UTC: incident-bot alert: latency & 5xx spike on canary
- 10:11 UTC: feature flag kill-switch executed -> immediate improvement
- 10:20 UTC: revert PR 6428 merged and promoted to canary -> stable metrics
- 10:45 UTC: handoff to jonathan.

jonathan.lee: thanks. we'll follow up with RCA and action items.
